title: Amusement park
content: okay I just came across this page.. super cool. I scrolled down for quite a bit on the top posts and didn’t see anything so hopefully this isn’t a repeat. I’ve gone to this amusement park probably hundreds of times since I was a kid. Anyone else’s “mall world” an amusement park?? It doesn’t look similar to any park I’ve actually gone to irl aside from the fact there’s roller coasters and games and stuff.. other than that the whole layout is like nothing I’ve ever seen. I hate that I can’t really describe it cause it’s kinda been a while since the last time I’ve been there… but it’s like MASSIVE! Lol like all of the rides are like 5x the size of any ride I’ve ever been to, and there’s always people around, sometimes I interact with them sometimes I don’t but every single time I’m there, I feel so disoriented and disorganized but it’s always SOOOO vivid. Another place I’ve gone to is more of like a huge apartment building/hotel with spiral stairs alll throughout the building and like 50 different pathways just to get around. It’s the same kind of thing, like very disorienting but at the same time I know what I’m doing? Ugh I wish I could describe this better! But the interesting thing about this place is, a friend of mine has been there too.. we had both dreamt of this place within days of each other.
